The '''Silvertree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that evolved on [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. Due to the high amount of solar radiation, the silvertree had very bright reflective bark. Because of this, they would glow with reflected light. The reflective light would put out a large amount of thermal energy, causing the native creatures of the forest to be nocturnal. Their wood was dark and thick with a high metal content.<ref name="AJ10" />
